editorial:
Imagine being a teacher who thinks he is just dealing with a difficult student, only to realize you are actually being hunted by a psycho. You get to follow Debbie, a rebellious teen who has had a rough start in life after her mom dies in a fire. She moves in with her grandma and starts acting out at school, specifically targeting her hot creative writing teacher, Peter. The vibe here is that classic late-90s thriller feel where a cute face hides a really dangerous mind. It starts off slow, but once Debbie decides that Peter belongs to her, the movie turns into a scary game of cat and mouse.

You will probably love how the tension builds up as Peter's friends start disappearing. The acting is solid, and the way the movie handles the obsession feels creepy and real. One downside is that some of the plot twists are a bit predictable, but it still keeps you on the edge of your seat. If you love stories about dangerous students, you should definitely check this out.

Peter realizes just how far Debbie has gone and has to fight back to save his fiancée. In the end, Debbie's obsession leads to her own downfall. She is stopped before she can kill everyone, and the cycle of violence finally ends with her being defeated.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 90s thrillers and stories about dangerous obsessions.
